name: u1-chopper-resonance-tuner
title: Chopper Resonance Tuner for Snapmaker U1
author: Alexander Fedorov, Maksim Bolgov, Erkan Ozgur Yilmaz; Snapmaker U1 adaptation contributors
description: CoreXY-aware Chopper Resonance Tuner for Snapmaker U1 firmware 1.6 through 2.0. It isolates the X and Y TMC2240 motors with diagonal motion, supports the LDO-42STH48-2503MAC 0.9-degree upgrade, resolves both legacy and auto-identified toolhead accelerometers, and uses the U1's 12.5 MHz driver clock.
tagline: Tune either U1 CoreXY motor with the detected toolhead accelerometer.
attributions: Chopper Resonance Tuner is GPL-3.0-licensed upstream work by Alexander Fedorov, Maksim Bolgov, and Erkan Ozgur Yilmaz. The Snapmaker U1 adaptation adds Bespok3d packaging, firmware 1.6+/2.0 accelerometer resolution, U1-specific CoreXY/TMC2240 behavior, TMC Autotune-safe defaults, compatibility tests, and safety documentation. Bundled Python dependencies retain their own licence notices. Complete corresponding source is available in the public fork.
